caption: Most plans fail because we treat urgency as progress. This carousel gives five practical AI prompts to fix prioritisation at work. Save it for a repeatable weekly approach. What one task will you re-prioritise this week? #AI #Productivity #Prioritisation #Entrepreneurs

slides.title: Your to-do list rewards busywork
slides.body: Your to-do list rewards busywork over real outcomes. Here are five prompts to fix prioritisation.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose priorities
slides.body: Diagnose priorities: From [TASK LIST], rank top 3 by impact. Output: a numbered list with task, impact, and recommended order.

slides.title: 2. Improve focus
slides.body: Improve focus: Propose a three-item weekly plan from ranked tasks, allocating time by impact. Output: brief plan with time blocks.

slides.title: 3. Apply plan
slides.body: Apply plan: Create a day-by-day schedule for a 5-day sprint, focusing on top priority task first. Output: calendar-style list.

slides.title: 4. Check outcomes
slides.body: Check results: After the day, evaluate if top-priority task advanced milestone; Output: score 1-5 and blockers.

slides.title: 5. Refine workflow
slides.body: Refine workflow: Turn this into a reusable weekly template with a checklist and a one-click reminder. Output: template and checklist.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Prioritise by impact, not urgency; a repeatable weekly plan keeps your best work moving forward.
